description: Create a share link for a document. Optionally set an expiration date and file version (archive or original). Share links can't be edited afterwards — to change the expiry, delete and recreate. To share several documents as one ZIP link, use create_share_link_bundle.

expiration.description: Expiration date-time in ISO format, or null for no expiry

file_version.description: Which file version to share (default: archive)

name: create_share_link
